archetypes.name: ref-completeness
archetypes.rationale: Diff touches 4 doc files but the plan lists additional files (scripts/test-render-voter-prompt.md, render-voter-prompt.md) that may still carry stale references; need to verify coverage is complete.
archetypes.prompt_body: The diff updates cross-references in four documentation files to point from `skills/implement/SKILL.md` to `skills/implement/references/step5-review-branches.md` or `skills/implement/references/preflight-plan-audit.md`. The plan (Items 1–4 and their sub-items) names additional files not present in the diff, including `scripts/test-render-voter-prompt.md` and `render-voter-prompt.md`, that may still carry stale `skills/implement/SKILL.md` citations. Check whether the four touched files fully satisfy the plan's stated scope, or whether the omitted files represent overlooked stale references. Also verify that the new target paths (`skills/implement/references/preflight-plan-audit.md` and `skills/implement/references/step5-review-branches.md`) actually exist in the repository and that the surrounding prose in each changed file remains coherent after the update. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: cross-doc-consistency
archetypes.rationale: Four docs each substitute a different target path; a reviewer should confirm the substituted path is spelled correctly and maps to the right authority in each context.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine each of the four changed files to verify that the newly substituted reference path is used correctly in context: `agnix-fix/SKILL.md` now cites `preflight-plan-audit.md` for Preflight adequacy-audit behavior; `docs/issue-anchored-plan.md` cites `preflight-plan-audit.md` for plan-quality enforcement; `review-implement-step5-loop.md` extends the stall-seed contract pointer to include `step5-review-branches.md`; and `skills/review/SKILL.md` redirects the MAV OOS-rubric authority to `step5-review-branches.md`. For each change, confirm the cited file name is spelled correctly, that the surrounding prose accurately describes what the referenced document contains, and that no neighbouring sentences still reference the old `skills/implement/SKILL.md` location for the same concern. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
